title: settings_load_at reads the entire dotfile into memory before any size bound
evidence:
data, err := os.read_entire_file_from_path(path, context.temp_allocator)
	if err != nil || len(data) < 6 {
detail: The length check runs after the full read; an oversized/corrupt ~/.pp-settings.bin causes an unbounded allocation before the 6-byte contract is checked.
recommended_fix: Stat the file first and reject (fall back to defaults) above a small bound (e.g. 1 KiB) before reading.

title: Compiled Python bytecode still tracked: tools/__pycache__/derive_a11y_palettes.cpython-313.pyc
detail: Stale compiled artifact in the tree; if the .py and .pyc ever diverge, Python executes the stale bytecode — a silent-integrity risk on the palette-derivation tool.
recommended_fix: git rm --cached the .pyc and add __pycache__/ to .gitignore.
